front_blocks.md: Why must accountants comply with the accounting concepts?

back_blocks.md: So that a business's financial statements can be **accurately compared** with those of similar businesses.
They also let an owner compare the **year-by-year performance** of their own business.

cards.front_md: Why must accountants comply with the accounting concepts?
cards.back_md:
So that a business's financial statements can be **accurately compared** with those of similar businesses.

They also let an owner compare the **year-by-year performance** of their own business.

back_blocks.md: Financial statements **only record and report on business activities**.
The owner's personal assets, expenses and liabilities are kept out; money they put in is **capital** and money they take out is **drawings**.

cards.back_md:

back_blocks.md: The assumption that a business will **continue to operate into the foreseeable future**, carrying on its current trading.
That is why assets are recorded at cost or net book value rather than at what they would fetch if sold.

front_blocks.md: Complete the sentence about the duality concept:
Each transaction is recorded using two accounting entries of `\_\_\_\_\_\_` and `\_\_\_\_\_\_` values.

back_blocks.md: Each transaction is recorded using two accounting entries of **opposite** and **equal** values.

cards.front_md:

cards.back_md:

front_blocks.md: A business may change its method of depreciation.

back_blocks.md: Consistency requires the same method to be used each year, but it **can** be changed where there is a good reason. The decision and its impact then have to be recorded.

cards.front_md:
**True or False?**

A business may change its method of depreciation.
cards.back_md:
**True.**

Consistency requires the same method to be used each year, but it **can** be changed where there is a good reason. The decision and its impact then have to be recorded.

front_blocks.md: A business owner receives a bad review from a customer. Why is it not entered in the accounting records?

back_blocks.md: Only transactions involving money are reported, so non-monetary information such as reviews, reputation and staff experience is left out.

cards.front_md: A business owner receives a bad review from a customer. Why is it not entered in the accounting records?
cards.back_md:
Because of **money measurement**.

Only transactions involving money are reported, so non-monetary information such as reviews, reputation and staff experience is left out.

front_blocks.md: The rent has not been paid, but the amount still appears in the statement of profit or loss. Which concept is that?

back_blocks.md: Incomes and expenses are matched to the year in which the benefit was gained, whatever has actually been paid.

cards.front_md: The rent has not been paid, but the amount still appears in the statement of profit or loss. Which concept is that?
cards.back_md:
**Matching**, also called accruals.

Incomes and expenses are matched to the year in which the benefit was gained, whatever has actually been paid.

front_blocks.md: Unused paper clips at the year end are treated as an expense rather than an asset. Which concept is that?

back_blocks.md: Items of low monetary value are grouped rather than given their own accounts, because tracking them separately would cost more than the information is worth.

cards.front_md: Unused paper clips at the year end are treated as an expense rather than an asset. Which concept is that?
cards.back_md:
**Materiality**.

Items of low monetary value are grouped rather than given their own accounts, because tracking them separately would cost more than the information is worth.
